notes.title: Developer Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I'll be using this space to share updates from time to time on the game's progress.

Lately, I’ve been focused on improving the art and visual effects based on earlier feedback. It’s been a bit of a rollercoaster. The upside of being a solo developer/artist is that I get to experiment and have fun trying new things. The downside? I have to do all the work myself.

I also made what might have been a dumb (or maybe smart) decision to upgrade my project to a newer engine version. Thankfully, it didn’t explode! In fact, it has actually improved my workflow and sped up testing, though I did lose some initial time wrestling with bugs from the upgrade.

Anyway, here’s a backdrop of some scenery I just created to give you a feel for how the art is shaping up. Hope you like it!
